design: 4 archived v2 sources x 17 fixed cases x 4 cumulative validation layers; deterministic exhaustive cases, no random sampling.
primary_estimand: Observed rejections of the 52 predeclared in-band invalid artifacts, by cumulative layer; descriptive finite-suite counts only.
controls: 4 untouched artifacts; report false rejections separately.
unknowns: 12 unobservable-scenario probes excluded from detection denominators; report technical verdict and epistemic unknown separately.

layer_contract.syntax: Strict JSON parse; rejects nonstandard NaN/Infinity tokens.
layer_contract.structure: Syntax plus the archived structural JSON Schema: required fields, local types/ranges, no cross-record reconciliation.
layer_contract.aggregates: Structure plus task/group/overall outcomes, episode count, stream lengths, per-phase inference list/count agreement and warm-up total.
layer_contract.full_ledger: Aggregates plus existing validate_completed: hashes, stream action equality, identities, seeds, chronology and chunk schedule.

legacy_applicability: The aggregate layer is an explicit ablation of v2 evidence, not a claim that historical v1 stored equivalent streams. V1 originals are excluded because they cannot support action/identity mutation trials.
claim_limits: Constructed mutations were chosen with knowledge of validator requirements; this evaluates specified mechanisms, not natural error prevalence.
Four source artifacts share one task/state and include a replay; they are stress-test contexts, not independent robot replicates.
No confidence interval, human-reader benefit, policy quality, robustness under physical perturbations, or end-to-end lifecycle completeness is estimated.
Jointly consistent alterations and out-of-boundary stages require an external oracle; a pass is not proof of truthful or complete collection.

case_manifest.label: Untouched archived artifact
case_manifest.intervention: No mutation; accepted in-band data does not establish completeness outside its scope.

case_manifest.label: Invalid JSON
case_manifest.intervention: Remove final closing brace; violates JSON grammar.

case_manifest.label: Missing environment event
case_manifest.intervention: Remove final consumer event but retain producer stream and selection counter.

case_manifest.label: Duplicate environment event
case_manifest.intervention: Append final consumer event without changing independent streams/counters.

case_manifest.label: Action with stale hash
case_manifest.intervention: Change first consumer action value while retaining original hash.

case_manifest.label: Producer/consumer action mismatch
case_manifest.intervention: Change first consumer action and recompute its valid hash; producer stream stays original.

case_manifest.label: Episode identity mismatch
case_manifest.intervention: Increment episode task ID only; inference identities and task outcomes stay original.

case_manifest.label: Outcome aggregate mismatch
case_manifest.intervention: Replace overall success percentage with the opposite binary outcome; task/group outcomes stay original.

case_manifest.label: Missing completed-result wrapper
case_manifest.intervention: Remove overall result; remaining ledger alone cannot establish completed evaluator output.

case_manifest.label: Reordered steps
case_manifest.intervention: Swap first two consumer events; counts and action hashes stay valid.

case_manifest.label: Duplicate chunk; balanced counts
case_manifest.intervention: Append a measured inference and increment both counters; aggregate counts agree but schedule duplicates.

case_manifest.label: Missing timing field/unit
case_manifest.intervention: Rename first inference cuda_ms to duration, losing the declared clock/unit field.

case_manifest.label: Warm-up after measured event
case_manifest.intervention: Move first warm-up event to end; all event and counter totals stay unchanged.

case_manifest.label: Joint action rewrite
case_manifest.intervention: Change both first action streams and recompute hashes. Without an external expected-action reference, an internally consistent record cannot certify which action occurred.

case_manifest.label: Unlogged preprocessing coverage
case_manifest.intervention: Unchanged bytes; ask whether all preprocessing was accounted for. No independent expected-stage manifest or preprocessing cost is available. This is an unknown coverage query, not an invented measured omission.

case_manifest.label: Unlogged rendering coverage
case_manifest.intervention: Unchanged bytes; ask whether rendering costs were fully included. No independent stage-level rendering record is available. This is an unknown coverage query, not an invented measured omission.
